events.title: Múlinn Jazz Club: Sigurður Flosason Quartet
events.blurb: The Sigurður Flosason Quartet plays groovy jazz-blues at Múlinn Jazz Club in Harpa's top-floor Björtuloft hall — sax, Hammond organ, guitar and drums from veterans of the Icelandic jazz scene.

events.title: Múlinn Jazz Club: Sigurður Flosason Quartet
events.blurb: Second night of the Sigurður Flosason Quartet's jazz-blues set at Múlinn Jazz Club, in Harpa's Björtuloft hall with harbour views.

events.title: David Byrne in Eldborg
events.blurb: Talking Heads legend David Byrne plays Harpa's flagship Eldborg hall (Sena Live). Doors 19:30; most seating tiers already sold out — only A and Gold seats remain.

events.title: Japan–Iceland Friendship Concert: JMSDF Band
events.blurb: Free outdoor concert by the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Training Squadron band on the square outside Harpa, marking the squadron's first-ever port call to Reykjavík.

events.title: How to Become Icelandic in 60 Minutes
events.blurb: Long-running one-man comedy show in English: learn to walk, talk and behave like a regular Icelander in one hour. A hilarious blend of stand-up and theater in Harpa's Kaldalón hall.

events.title: Harpa Guided Tour
events.blurb: Guided tour of Harpa's award-winning architecture and concert halls. Departures at 11:00 and 13:00 this day.

events.title: Harpa Guided Tour
events.blurb: Guided tour of Harpa's award-winning architecture and concert halls. Departures at 11:00 and 13:00 this day.

events.title: Petals & Friends Quartet at Mengi
events.blurb: Intimate show at Mengi, Reykjavík's longest-running independent venue for creative and experimental music, on Óðinsgata just off Skólavörðustígur.

events.title: Comedy Open Mic at Snorribar
events.blurb: Comedy in Iceland's weekly English-language stand-up open mic, every Wednesday at 8pm — seasoned comics testing new material alongside first-timers, hosted by Eggert Smári. Happy-hour beer prices until showtime.

events.title: Open Mic Night at Útópía
events.blurb: Free open mic every Thursday at 8:30pm in Útópía's cozy second-floor room — comedy, songs, poems and stories in front of a friendly crowd. Thursday deal: bucket of five beers for 6.000 kr.

events.title: Live Music Every Night at American Bar
events.blurb: The venue's site promises 'live music every night' — troubadour-style sets in the heart of the downtown bar strip. Evening sets; exact start time varies. Open until 1am on weeknights, happy hour 4–7pm.
